Stable trusted Git commit/tree/object mappings and independently selected runtime remain prerequisites. Blob bytes are additionally verified against Git object identities. This is not a general Git fsck/metadata sandbox.
Several malformed/status/parser faults establish precise diagnostic or decode/order contracts while another later refusal remains.
batch-payload-lf is one compound two-check fault.

capture-array-copy is a broader alias fault whose recorded failure is entry mutation before splice; it does not independently prove outer-array-splice isolation. capture-entry-copy independently fails.

The initial identity oracle matched a downstream error echoing its invalid input. Only the stronger exact-diagnostic/no-ls-tree retry is canonical. Two identity tests changed between raw epochs; other proof oracles remain unchanged.
The prior cancellation gate also precedes malformed-revision validation, consistently treating already recorded cancellation as controlled exit.

The Git helper extraction is covered by the fresh C22 source-selection regression. Existing ambient/sync blob readers retain their owner and only share the pure decoder; the new capture path never invokes that owner.
Capture does not create a physical source tree, reserve outputs, validate filesystem collisions/symlink targets, build roles, prepare activations, archive, package or switch defaults.
